product_family: LightPDF is an AI-powered PDF editor, converter, and document processing suite available on Web, Mobile (iOS/Android), Desktop (Windows/Mac), and as browser extensions. Primary products include online PDF editing, conversion, OCR, signing, watermark removal, summarization, and AI chat for documents.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001 (Information Security Management)
certifications.proof_quote: About page claims compliance, but no public certificate, audit report, or proof link from vendor domain found. Privacy Policy and Terms of Service do not mention this certification. Claims appear unverified.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: About page claims compliance, but no public certificate or proof link from vendor domain found. Not mentioned in Privacy Policy or Terms of Service. Claims appear unverified.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: LightPDF adopts 'appropriate technical and organizational measures to help prevent unauthorized access to information and ensure data is held securely' in accordance with GDPR. Third parties required to complete 'Data Security Questionnaires' before receiving personal data.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1 or Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification found. Not mentioned on vendor website, About page, Privacy Policy, or Terms of Service.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance found. Healthcare is listed as a use case, but no formal HIPAA certification documented.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification found.

privacy.ai_training_note: LightPDF's AI Agent product page states 'Your data and the contents of your chats will not be used to train any AI models' and that documents are 'automatically deleted within 24 hours.' Communications are described as end-to-end encrypted. The general privacy policy does not itself address AI training.
privacy.data_region: Encrypted during transmission and processing. Vendor does not specify data residency region. Legal entity based in China (Shenzhen).

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Vendor states its AI Agent communications are 'end-to-end encrypted'; the privacy policy references appropriate technical and organizational measures to prevent unauthorized access. No specific TLS/SSL version is documented on the vendor domain.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Documents are stored temporarily only during processing and then deleted; vendor states communications are end-to-end encrypted. No specific at-rest encryption standard (e.g., AES-256) is published on the vendor's own domain.

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Files (including AI Agent documents) automatically deleted within 24 hours of processing per the vendor product page. Privacy policy notes deletion may have latency due to backup storage.

security.name: Third-party Security
security.value: Service providers required to complete Data Security Questionnaires. Data sharing with payment processors, analytics providers (Google Analytics, Facebook), and email delivery services. No explicit DPA mentioned.

security.name: Backup & Deletion Policy
security.value: Data deletion may be delayed due to backup storage. Data retained to comply with legal obligations.

products.name: Web Editor & Tools
products.data_scope: Files uploaded for processing, deleted within 24 hours. No local storage option.
products.notes: Available at lightpdf.com. Includes edit, convert, OCR, sign, compress, watermark removal, and summarization tools.

products.name: Desktop Apps (Windows/Mac)
products.data_scope: Primary processing on local machine with optional cloud sync.
products.notes: Lighter footprint than competitors. Synced across devices with single account.

products.name: Mobile Apps (iOS/Android)
products.data_scope: Files processed locally or uploaded to cloud temporarily.

products.name: Browser Extensions (Chrome/Edge)
products.notes: Allows quick PDF editing from browser context.

products.name: AI PDF Agent & Chat
products.data_scope: Documents uploaded for AI processing. Not used for model training.
products.notes: Summarization, Q&A, translation powered by AI. Customer data not used for training.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: limited free tools, Pro subscription with unlimited features. Pricing described as 'half the cost of competitors' (e.g., Adobe).
compare.data_residency: Not specified by vendor. Data processed in cloud, encrypted in transit and during processing. Legal entity in China.
top_certs: GDPR (verified posture documented in privacy policy)

flags: OVER-CLAIM DETECTED: About page claims ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701 certification, but no public certificate, audit report, or proof link found on vendor domain. Privacy Policy and Terms of Service do not reference these certifications. Claims should be verified directly with vendor.
NO TRUST CENTER: Vendor does not maintain a dedicated trust center or compliance documentation page, unlike competitors (iLovePDF, Lumin, Adobe). All compliance info scattered across product pages.
DATA RESIDENCY UNCLEAR: Vendor does not specify where data is processed or backed up. Legal entity is in China (Shenzhen), which may raise concerns for regulated industries (healthcare, finance).
NO DPA DOCUMENTATION: Privacy Policy mentions third-party data sharing but does not reference Data Processing Agreements or standard contractual clauses for international transfers.
SOC 2 ABSENT: While claimed to be a growth-stage company (1M+ users), no SOC 2 certification found. Not required for consumer tools but increasingly expected for B2B use.
HIPAA USE CASE NOT BACKED: Healthcare listed as a use case on homepage, but no HIPAA compliance mentioned. Organizations handling PHI should verify independently.
LIMITED ENTERPRISE DOCUMENTATION: No visible compliance dashboard, audit trail features, or enterprise-grade SLA documentation compared to competitors.
